name: Intek Plastics
old_description: Our ESG IMPACT framework guides how we operate, invest, and improve across our people, our communities, and our planet. This page outlines our goals, metrics, and progress with transparency and accountability.
about:
Intek Plastics operates from Eau Claire, Wisconsin. The company emerged from the combination of Five Star Plastics and 3D Printing Ally, unifying their capabilities under the Intek Plastics, LLC name.

The company provides full-spectrum plastic manufacturing, including precision injection molding, multi-material and co-extrusion, plastic prototyping via 3D printing and cast urethane molding, and in-house tooling. Secondary operations cover pad printing, laser marking, drilling, machining, protective coatings, assembly, and kitting, supported by inventory management and just-in-time delivery. The facility handles both low-volume prototype runs and high-volume extruded profiles.

Intek serves OEMs in fenestration, data centers, aerospace and defense, off-highway equipment, medical devices and dental, HVAC/R, consumer goods, and industrial markets. Customers rely on the company for components that meet strict regulatory and performance requirements.

Intek differentiates itself through its ESG IMPACT framework, which drives sustainability initiatives such as bioplastic composites and regrind programs. Quality systems earned ISO 9001:2015 Noteworthy Recognition in 2025, with customer quality ratings above 99%, DPPM below 1,000, and RMA rates well below industry benchmarks. The company also holds AS9100D, UL, FDA, and ITAR certifications, and was named a 2025 Processor of the Year finalist for Industry and Public Service.
